whatIs: ShaderGradient is a tool for creating animated 3D gradients and bringing them to React, Figma or Framer. In React it's used with the @shadergradient/react package, which offers the ShaderGradient and ShaderGradientCanvas components; there's also a Vue version.
It's a good fit when you want an eye-catching moving background, like a hero's, without hand-building a 3D scene.
uses: Putting an animated gradient background in the main section of a React landing page.
Designing the gradient in Figma or Framer and reusing the same style on the final site.
Visually tuning colors and motion, and copying the parameters into the component.
caveats: It's a 3D scene on a canvas: measure performance on mobile and low-end machines.
The renderer depends on WebGL, so plan a fallback in case the browser doesn't support it.
A full-screen animated background can distract from the content; use it sparingly.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; there's no paid plan.
idealFor: React projects that want animated 3D backgrounds without writing shaders.
